blind.description: A low, messy heap of sewer waste and sludge. It contains embedded objects including a broken wooden barrel with metal hoops, chopped logs and sticks, small bones, a human skull, red cloth fragments, and pebbles, all partially coated in glossy greenish-brown slime and muck. The objects are fused together into a coherent low pile that sits flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A rounded, lumpy pile of dark sludge, scattered wooden logs, a fragmented wooden barrel, red patches, slimy green coating, and a distinct pale skull near the upper edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/8 to 1/7 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 8 to 10 inches tall), and about half its height in diameter (around 2.5 to 3 feet wide).
